- Pre-race standings: Antonelli 302 pts, Russell 236 pts
- Malaysia result: Antonelli P2 (+18 pts) = 320 pts; Russell DNF = 236 pts
- New gap: 84 points (from 66 before Malaysia)
- Rounds remaining after Malaysia: 7 (Rounds 17-23)
- Singapore Sprint (Round 17) adds bonus 8 points
- Max remaining points: 6 GPs x 25 = 150, plus Singapore Sprint = 8 total = 158 max
- Russell maximum total possible: 236 + 158 = 394
- Antonelli needs 395 to clinch — currently at 320, needs 75 more from 7 rounds
- With 6 wins + Sprint win: 25*6 + 8 = 158 — plenty of cushion
